claims.feature: other: the record is unrevisable once printed
claims.claim: Wolfe says print cannot be revised: once it is out, it is out for all time.

claims.claim: Wolfe says he has never been able to catch and correct the printed assertion that he was editor of Plant Engineering, when he was a senior editor on the staff.

claims.quote: I was actually a senior editor on the staff
claims.page: Wolfe's reply to Price, first paragraph

claims.claim: Naming his Plant Engineering beats, Wolfe glosses each abstract department with a parenthesis of concrete objects.

claims.page: Wolfe's reply to Price, second paragraph

claims.claim: Wolfe says a Plant Engineering senior editor had to supply cover articles, meaning write them and take the pictures himself.
claims.source: Gene Wolfe, written reply to Nigel Price, 'Gene Wolfe's time at Plant Engineering', Ultan's Library, 2013
claims.quote: meaning write the articles and take the pictures
claims.page: Wolfe's reply to Price, first paragraph

claims.feature: other: the record that does not survive

claims.claim: Ultan's Library dates Wolfe's Plant Engineering employment 1972 to 1984.

claims.confidence: high: the figure is on the page; the conflict with ultan.org.uk/plant-engineering/ is stated by comparison of the two pages, both fetched

claims.claim: Wolfe says being the Letters to the Editor editor at Plant Engineering was good and fun and taught him a lot of stuff.

claims.quote: which was good and fun and taught me a lot

claims.claim: Asked to name the best editors he had worked with, Wolfe named David Hartwell first and called him his principal editor.
claims.source: Gene Wolfe, interviewed by Lawrence Person, 'Suns New, Long, and Short', Nova Express Vol 5 No 1, Fall/Winter 1998 (blog reprint 2021)
claims.quote: He's been my principal editor over the years

claims.claim: Wolfe placed Damon Knight second among the editors he had worked with, after Hartwell.
claims.source: Gene Wolfe, interviewed by Lawrence Person, 'Suns New, Long, and Short', Nova Express Vol 5 No 1, Fall/Winter 1998 (blog reprint 2021)
claims.quote: Damon Knight would have to come in second

claims.claim: Wolfe says Hartwell asked him to add a closing paragraph stating that Severian leaves Urth and saves the sun.
claims.source: Gene Wolfe, interviewed by Lawrence Person, 'Suns New, Long, and Short', Nova Express Vol 5 No 1, Fall/Winter 1998 (blog reprint 2021)
claims.quote: David Hartwell said that I should put a paragraph in at the end

claims.claim: Wolfe answered his editor that the requested closing paragraph was more than a paragraph.

claims.quote: David, that's more than a paragraph.
